cohort: The cohort included 47,582 pregnancies from the Danish National Birth Cohort (1996-2002), where the woman was pregnant at 22 gestational weeks, expected one child and worked 30 hours/week.
finding: The study found a statistically significant interaction between occupational lifting and psychosocial job strain for small and large for gestational age, but not for gestational length.
gest_age: Participants were selected if pregnant at 22 gestational weeks; gestational length was an outcome measured at birth.
